thread:
alex: FYI Customer Y saw a 500 on /v1/chat when they actually hit a tenant quota. They expected 429. Happened on dedicated routing.
miya: ouch. can you paste response + headers?
alex: ```http
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route: rt-92
X-Quota-Checked: late
X-Fallback: true

{ \"error\": \"shard_unavailable\" }
```
jordan: That looks like quota was enforced after routing, then the shard failed and bubbled up a 5xx. We only normalize quota->429 at the gateway ingress, so anything checked later becomes a 500 to the client.
nishant: This is a contract gap. For dedicated/multi-tenant setups we sometimes do admission checks in the route. If the route rejects for quota after we've forwarded, clients get confusing 5xx.
sam: Suggested fix: gateway should canonicalize client-visible status based on the final decision path. If any component annotates the final cause as quota, translate to 429 and set structured headers: `X-Client-Status: quota_exceeded`, `X-Quota-Origin: route|ingress`, `X-Quota-Reason: tenant_limit`. If it's a pure infra problem, send 5xx but add `X-Client-Status: infra_error`. This gives SDKs a clear signal.
miya: Streaming caveat: if we detect quota mid-stream we can't change HTTP status code. For streaming responses emit a terminal marker event like `{\"type\":\"terminal\",\"client_status\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"code\":429}` and close stream. We should document that pattern.
jordan: Telemetry needs to capture `client_visible_status` and tag with `quota_origin`, `route_id`, and `quota_subcode`. Current dashboards only show status_code and route; we lose whether quota is root cause.
alex: Console UX: add per-route banner copy: "This route is limited by tenant quota. Visit Quotas to request higher limits or contact support." Tooltip should link to per-route quota history and a 'request increase' action.
nishant: Rollout plan: add a feature-flag `normalize_client_status` at the gateway. Canary 10% for 48h, watch: 1) 429s up (expected), 2) 5xx infra rate not increasing, 3) SDKs misclassifying errors. Create an alert if infra 5xx rate rises > 5% over baseline.
miya: SDK docs: treat 429 as backoffable (client should back off and retry later), treat 5xx as transient retryable. Show sample snippet to inspect `X-Client-Status` header and handle stream terminal events.
sam: I'll own gateway rewrite PR. @jordan you'll update rewriting logic and add unit tests. @nishant will add telemetry tags and update the dashboard. @miya will update SDK docs and streaming guidelines. @alex will propose console copy + help center note.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: feat/normalize-client-status -> gateway-canary (10%)
jordan: Draft PR posted in #pull-requests. Added tests for header rewrite + streaming terminal event.
alex: I'll send a customer note explaining they saw a 500 due to late quota enforcement and that we're rolling a change so quota errors show as 429 with links to quota docs. :thumbsup: 
sam: Ops note: ensure logs include both `client_visible_status` and `internal_cause` fields to speed debugging. Don't force cross-service grep.
miya: good call. I'll set a 30m follow-up if canary shows any anomalies.
alex: thanks all. keep comments in the PR for copy and telemetry naming.
